svg.title: 120 neurons make the edited model stop
svg.desc: Recorded Qwen3.8-27B activity on a selected harmful benchmark request after abliteration. The ordinary model produces a harmful answer. With the tripwire it produces zero answer tokens. Dots sample individual neurons across 64 layers.

g.text: 120 neurons make the edited model stop
Qwen3.8-27B · recorded activity before the first answer token · same prompt, same weight edit
Each mark is a sampled neuron. Orange shows the measured change from the ordinary model.
One selected harmful request from an eight-request recording. All 40 condition/request pairs are reported.
